name: Gardener (Metamagic)
body:
All plant-based spells are cast as if you were two levels higher.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast control plants.

Benefit: Whenever you cast a spell that alters, controls, creates, repels or summons a living plant, you cast the spell at your current level plus two. This feat has no affect on spells that transmute or manipulate wood. Spells influenced by this feat include control plants, diminish plants, entangle and plant growth. Spells such as warp wood and wood shape do not receive the benefits of this feat because they alter the properties of non-living plant material.
